admission.justification: Benign index refreshes would otherwise become false actor failures, hiding real semantic Git effects among filesystem noise.

applicability: Eval admission and grading of retained Git repository effects.
conditions: Retained HEAD/branch, refs, cached-diff paths and indexed mode/blob/stage values determine endpoint effects.
Index stat-cache, reflog and equivalent ref-storage churn are not actor violations by themselves.
exclusions: A promise that equal endpoints prove no transient Git operation occurred.
Permission for actual staging, branch, commit or stash changes.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Git admission compares semantic state rather than .git byte writes so index/stat-cache noise does not become an actor violation.
